変.meaning: A <part>jellyfish</part> wobbles up the beach and sits down in a <part>folding chair</part>, puts on sunglasses and orders a lemonade. The other sunbathers stare. You don't see that every day. Very <kanji>unusual</kanji>.
変.on: Then a <sound>hen</sound> sits down in the next chair and orders the same.
変.kun: Next day the jellyfish has changed into a <sound>ca</sound>rp, still in the same chair.

危.meaning: An <part>unlucky</part> man stands at the edge of a cliff throwing a <part>boomerang</part>. It swings wide, turns, and comes whistling straight back at his head. He ducks, wobbles, nearly falls. This hobby is <kanji>dangerous</kanji>.
危.on: As he ducks, his car <sound>key</sound> slips out of his pocket and over the edge.
危.kun: '<sound>Ah</sound>!' he shouts, as a runaway <sound>bu</sound>lldozer rolls toward the cliff edge too.

公.meaning: <part>Eight</part> strangers stand elbow to <part>elbow</part> around a park fountain that belongs to nobody and everybody. Anyone can sit on its benches, drink from it or splash in it. It's <kanji>public</kanji>.
公.on: All eight line up for an ice cream <sound>co</sound>ne from the van by the gate.
公.kun: Under a big <sound>oa</sound>k, a park stall sells balls of <sound>ya</sound>rn and squirts of <sound>ke</sound>tchup to anyone at all.

青.meaning: A <part>TV antenna</part> on a rooftop points up at the <part>moon</part>, but the night is so clear that the sky never goes black. It stays a deep, glowing <kanji>blue</kanji> all the way to dawn.
青.on: Even the steel <sound>sa</sound>fe in the attic has been painted blue to match.
青.kun: '<sound>Ah</sound>… <sound>oh</sound>!' you sigh, then gasp, at how blue the sky is.

晴.meaning: A grumpy man stomps through town under a huge umbrella, moaning about the rain. A kid tugs his sleeve and points: the <part>sun</part> is out, people are in shorts, the sky is <part>blue</part> from edge to edge. He peeks out and blinks. It decided to <kanji>clear up</kanji> an hour ago.
晴.on: Red-faced, he folds the umbrella and locks it away in a steel <sound>sa</sound>fe.
晴.kun: He hides in a beach <sound>hu</sound>t, the only one in town still dripping wet.

広.meaning: You stick out an <part>elbow</part> in your old <part>shed</part> and hit nothing. Stretch both arms: still nothing. The walls seem miles away, and there's room for a tractor. This shed is <kanji>wide</kanji>.
広.on: There's room to park an ice cream van inside and sell a <sound>co</sound>ne to everyone.
広.kun: In high <sound>hee</sound>ls, a <sound>ro</sound>dent tap-dances from one far wall to the other.

万.meaning: A <part>one</part>-plank shelf runs across the top of a bank vault, and from it a hooked <part>pole</part> bends down into a long <part>slash</part> of a slide. Coins pour down it all night, clinking into a pile, until the counter finally clicks over: <kanji>ten thousand</kanji>.
万.on: A cheeky <sound>mon</sound>key slides down after the coins and stuffs its cheeks with them, counting every one.
万.kun: The monkey trades the lot for a pot of <sound>yo</sound>gurt, a pet <sound>ro</sound>dent and a ticket to the <sound>zoo</sound>.
